note: Root cause: src/glsl.js mobStepData gave an exactly degenerate Mobius map (ad - bc = 0) a NaN point at -d/c, because CX.mobApply is 0/0 there. Since review math-6 the CPU (funcs.js mobiusBuild) returns the constant a/c at that point. Now a map with CX.mobDetZero(m) gets no NaN point, so the GPU returns the constant too. Nearly degenerate maps keep their NaN point, as before. Re-run: glsl-test 0 failures in 3,891,045 compared values (was 16). The filter=blaschke run: 0 failures. Evidence: notes/v15-patch1-evidence/glsl_full.json, glsl_bl.json.

Same root cause and fix as gate-glsl-test. Re-run: 304 failures, exactly v14's known set: the per-chain counts equal v14's (notes/gate-v15-r1/evidence/acc_glsladv_v14.json). The 459 new failures at z = -d/c of degenerate Mobius and Blaschke steps are gone. gl-test light and dark: 20 comparisons each, 0 px difference. glsl_inverse_cmd passed on this glsl.js (walk, clip, fs flat and sphere, flip). Evidence: notes/v15-patch1-evidence/glsladv_full.json, gltest_light.json, gltest_dark.json, glsl_inverse.json.

Not a v15 regression, so not fixed in the code, and no baseline or accepted entry was changed. The check is new and absolute: one SphereMesh slice must take at most 6 ms; the app runs the job in 5 ms idle slices. It failed only at the gate under load 3 to 13 (6.2 ms). Paired against v14 it passed on both builds, and the v14 gate saw it fail on v13 and v14 too. Re-run now, paired against the v15 gate snapshot at load about 2: max slice 4.6 ms on v15.1 and 4.6 ms on v15, pass on both. The same paired subset (image.default.m240, phase.default, examples, scrub, scrub.morph, morph.open, morph.play.views, hover.default, image.custom_e_z1z.m240, scrub.mobius_halfplane: 422 metrics) gave PASS 288, IMPROVED 2, INFO 130 and FAIL 2. The 2 FAILs are scrub.mobius_halfplane GPU live and peak bytes (one more texture, +896 KiB). They are not caused by the patch: three more paired runs of that unit, with the reference set to the gate snapshot itself, to the gate snapshot plus the new glsl.js, and to the gate snapshot plus only the changed glsl.js line, all gave the same 1,774,496 live bytes and 7 textures on both builds. The texture count of this unit depends on the run, not on the code. Evidence: notes/v15-patch1-evidence/perf_subset_vs_v15.log, perf_subset_cur.json, perf_subset_ref_v15gate.json, perf_gpumem_check1..3_*.json.

test/tour_cmd.js: the reduced-motion check no longer waits a fixed 320 ms. It records the shade path every frame until it has changed and then held for two frames (at most 3 s), and requires a 0 s card transition, a changed cut-out, at most 3 distinct paths (a 320 ms tween would show one per frame) and the same path 300 ms later. The first version of this new check (written before this session) could never pass: it returned the promise, and in the cdp daemon's REPL mode a returned promise comes back as {} (only a top-level await is awaited). The full run failed it with an empty result. Now the expression awaits the promise itself. The check alone, 3 runs: 0 s transition, 1 path, settled in 138 to 152 ms. A control run with motion allowed fails it (0.16 s transitions, 16 paths), so it still tells a jump from a tween. Full tour_cmd: 94 of 94; tour_lit_cmd: 78 of 78.
